seat.label: Claude Code (seat)
seat.note: Run Director without a provider, or type /studio run in Claude Code. Never behind a web route.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.note: Chat completions with tools. GPT-6 models need the Responses API (not built yet); pick a GPT-5.x id.

grok.label: Grok (xAI)
grok.note: Chat completions; xAI's docs now lead with the Responses API. The live check confirms.

gemini.label: Gemini
gemini.note: Text director through Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (beta). The same key makes brand images and clips (Brand tab → Generate).

claude.label: Claude API
claude.note: Anthropic Messages API with the person's own API key. Never the Claude Code OAuth token; the seat child still gets no key.

qwen.label: Qwen (DashScope)
qwen.note: Compatible mode. Keys are region-bound; the newer per-workspace host is https://<WorkspaceId>.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1. Set vision true for a qwen3-vl id.
